messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "nausea and vomiting associated with moderately to highly emetogenic chemotherapy"
set: ["nausea and vomiting associated with moderately to highly emetogenic chemotherapy", "prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with moderately emetogenic cancer chemotherapy", "nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of emetogenic chemotherapy", "nausea and vomiting associated with radiotherapy", "nausea and vomiting associated with MEC", "reduces nausea and vomiting", "nausea with or without vomiting", "nausea and vomiting caused by pregnancy", "prevention of postoperative nausea and vomiting", "severe upper stomach pain spreading to back with nausea and vomiting", "medicine for prevention of nausea and vomiting", "with nausea", "unexplained stomach or intestinal problems with nausea and vomiting or diarrhea", "blocking the actions of chemicals that trigger nausea and vomiting", "chemotherapy", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to prevent nausea and vomiting"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
